items.title: 20.4.2 Side Chain Oxidation in Benzene (benzene ki side chain ka oxidation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.4.2, printed page 67.

blocks.text: Benzene ring se seedha jure alkyl group par hone wali oxidation ko side-chain oxidation kehte hain. Is reaction mein alkylbenzenes alkaline KMnO₄, acidic K₂Cr₂O₇ ya dilute HNO₃ se aasani se oxidise ho jate hain. Alkyl group chhota ho ya bara, woh carboxylic acid group (–COOH) ban jata hai, aur benzene ring intact (salamat, bina toote) rehti hai.

blocks.alt: Toluene + 3[O], arrow ke oopar Heat, se benzoic acid (ring par COOH) + H2O.
blocks.caption: Toluene ki side-chain oxidation (kitab ke PDF page 70 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Side-chain oxidation tab hoti hai jab ring se jure carbon par kam az kam ek benzylic hydrogen ho. Benzylic hydrogen na ho to reaction nahi hota. Is liye ring se jure tertiary carbon (jis par koi H nahi) par yeh reaction asar nahi karta.
Alkyl group kitna bhi lamba ho, oxidation ke baad us ki jagah sirf ek carboxyl group banta hai. Neeche ki misal dikhati hai ke is reaction se substituted benzoic acid kaise banaya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen reactions, arrow ke oopar KMnO4 aur neeche H+: CH2-R wali benzene ring se C(=O)OH wali ring; tetralin, yani saturated six-membered (chhe carbon wali) ring se juri benzene ring, se benzene ring jis ke do parosi carbons par C(=O)OH; CR3 wali benzene ring: No Reaction (koi reaction nahi).
blocks.caption: KMnO4 se side-chain oxidation (kitab ke PDF page 70 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli misal: ring par CH₂–R ho to poori chain hat kar sirf –COOH bachta hai (benzoic acid). Doosri: tetralin (benzene ring ke saath juri saturated ring) ke dono benzylic carbons –COOH ban jate hain (benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid). Teesri: ring par CR₃ (tertiary carbon, koi benzylic H nahi), is liye koi reaction nahi.

Alkane aur benzene dono alag alag bohat stable hain aur aasani se oxidise nahi hote, lekin jab dono jur jayein to ring se seedha jura benzylic carbon zyada reactive ho jata hai aur aasani se oxidise hota hai.

Benzylic protons wale alkylbenzene ki KMnO₄ se oxidation identification test (pehchan ke test) ke taur par use hoti hai. Oxidation mein KMnO₄ kharch hota hai to us ke solution ka purple (jamni) colour ud jata hai. Is test se benzene aur tertiary alkyl group wale benzene (rang nahi badalta) ko primary ya secondary alkyl group wale benzene (rang ud jata hai) se alag pehchana ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke KMnO₄ test se benzene, primary, secondary aur tertiary alkyl group wale benzenes sab ek doosre se alag pehchane ja sakte hain. Lekin primary aur secondary dono groups mein benzylic hydrogen hai aur dono rang uda dete hain, is liye in dono mein farq is test se nahi hota. Test sirf yeh batata hai: rang ud gaya (primary ya secondary) ya nahi uda (benzene ya tertiary).

blocks.prompt: Toluene, tert-butylbenzene aur benzene mein se kaun garam karne par acidic KMnO₄ ka rang udata hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf toluene: is ke CH₃ group mein benzylic hydrogens hain aur woh –COOH ban jata hai. Benzene ki koi side chain nahi, aur tert-butyl group mein benzylic H nahi.

items: Benzylic H wali alkyl side chain –COOH ban jati hai (KMnO₄, K₂Cr₂O₇ ya dilute HNO₃).
Ring intact (salamat) rehti hai; tertiary alkyl group react nahi karta.
KMnO₄ ka purple colour udna benzylic H ki nishani hai.
